Promotional Text: Turn recipe links, text, and photos into a cookbook you can actually cook from. Adjust servings, follow clear steps, and build your shopping list.
Description:
Keep the recipe. Lose the clutter.

LinkDish brings the recipes you want to cook into one organized cookbook. Import a public recipe link, paste recipe text, or choose a recipe photo. With your permission, Google Gemini helps turn submitted content into structured ingredients and cooking steps. Always check imported details before cooking.

YOUR COOKBOOK, READY WHEN YOU ARE
Save and edit recipes, keep your own notes, and find a favorite when it is time to cook.

COOK WITH CLEAR STEPS
Follow focused cooking instructions, check off ingredients, and use timers when a recipe includes them.

MAKE THE RIGHT AMOUNT
Adjust servings and add ingredients to a shopping list so you can plan the next meal.

TRY LINKDISH FREE
Start with 3 recipe imports total and save up to 15 personal recipes. LinkDish Plus Monthly includes 100 recipe imports each month and unlimited personal recipe saves. Sign in to subscribe or restore purchases.

Some websites require a login or block imports. When a link cannot be imported, try recipe text or a photo instead. Import results depend on the content provided.

Plus Monthly is an auto-renewing subscription. The current price and billing period are shown in the app before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel your subscription in App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://linkdish.ca/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Notes:
LinkDish organizes recipes into a personal cookbook. Build 37 uses the production API at api.linkdish.ca and production Clerk authentication.

Basic review: open Add, acknowledge the Google Gemini disclosure, and paste recipe text or a publicly accessible recipe link. Save the imported recipe, open it from Cookbook, adjust servings, use Cook mode, and add ingredients to Shopping. Photo imports are available from Add. Imported content is user-provided and should be checked for accuracy.

Subscription review: sign in, then open Account > View plans. This iOS release offers only LinkDish Plus Monthly (linkdish_plus_monthly): 100 recipe imports/month and unlimited personal recipe saves. The free plan includes 3 recipe imports total and up to 15 personal recipes. Restore purchases and Manage subscription are available in the app. Existing Family entitlements remain recognized, but Family and yearly plans are not offered for new purchase on iOS.

Account deletion is available from Account. The app does not require a local development server.
